comment: The third colour. These are POLICY refusals, decided on the record -- the sweep must report them as REFUSED-ON-PURPOSE and may never rediscover them as defects. A refusal turning up as LEFT_BEHIND in sweep output is a bug in the instrument, not in the app.

refusals.why: no data source the app can verify; a wrong 'accessible' strands someone at a staircase
occupancy forecasts are unverifiable marketing-grade data
prices unverifiable; zone NAMES shipped instead (checkable), validity claims refused
